{{Quote|My mother was on a field mission when the Empire invaded. Researching bioluminescent coral reefs. The coral species she was studying is only found in a particular part of Manaan... ...where the Imps sent Krallet Division to clear the way for their kolto platforms.|Wo Kasto|<ref name="Retribution" />}}
An '''individual''' was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Biologist/Legends|biologist]] and the mother of [[Wo Kasto]] and [[Mata (biologist)|Mata]].<ref name="Ear to the Water" /> Around [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.1}}</ref> she was killed during the [[Invasion of Manaan]] at the hands of [[Krallet Division]].<ref name="Retribution" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Wo Kasto's mother was first mentioned in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] mission "Ear to the Water," in the Manaan Daily Area introduced in Game Update 7.1: ''Digging Deeper'', released on [[August 2]], [[2022]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Digging Deeper">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20220802|text=Game Update 7.1 "Digging Deeper" is live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
